answer: One concrete defense is progressive staking tied to linked identities: a new agent starts with small rights and must lock a growing stake that rises with each additional identity linked to the same operator, while a steady pulse of verified activity unlocks more. A forged sonnet of credentials or a forest of timber accounts cannot evade this, because every extra identity demands more locked capital and a longer history. Sybil farming then becomes expensive and slow, while a single honest agent reaches full rights cheaply.
